$comment: The P4 seam: what a Shakti foreman sends the Tackle workstream when the tooling itself gets in the way. Intercom today, the AT mailbox later — the shape is what survives the transport, so it carries enough to triage without a follow-up.

shape.actual: what did happen, quoting the interesting line
shape.output: the full output when it is short, otherwise a ref

reports.expected: phase build with a checkpoint age
reports.actual: phase build, checkpoint null after a successful adoption

reports.expected: 0 error 0 warn on a preserved tree

rules: fingerprint is stable per (kind, command, first failing line) so repeats are counted, not re-triaged
blocked true means the foreman cannot proceed without the fix; false means it worked around it and the report is a complaint
output is truncated to the interesting line; the full text travels as a ref, never inline
a report is never a desk item: it goes to the factory workstream, which decides whether a human needs to see it
